sections.title: Chemical Engineering Laboratory
sections.description: Experimental studies in heat and mass transfer, separations and chemical reactors to verify theoretical concepts and learn laboratory techniques. Methods for analyzing and presenting data. Report preparation and the presentation of an oral technical report. Prerequisite required: CBE 3510 Heat and Mass Transport AND CBE 3710 Separation Processes.
